class_definition.door_no_package: image has >=1 human-drawn Door (/m/02dgv) box and zero Box boxes
class_definition.package_present: image has >=1 human-drawn Box (/m/025dyy) bounding box

dataset: Open Images 2018_04 train, human-drawn bounding boxes
limitations: Montage thumbnails (256px) could hide very small packages; full-resolution review of the single borderline case confirmed it is mail, not a parcel.
Audit covers the reserved 250-image sample, not all 4712 training images; full-set label noise is assumed similar but not directly measured.
Open Images 'Box' includes product packaging, not only shipping parcels; this matches the POD photo-quality use case (package visible vs not) but differs from doorstep-delivery photos in framing.
method: all 250 images viewed as labeled 5x5 montage sheets (10 sheets); each negative judged on whether any package/box/parcel is visible

door_no_package.borderline_detail: d7da82d0: mailbox overflowing with newspapers/mail; not a delivered parcel, counted as borderline not a failure

package_present.note: positives rest on human-drawn Box bounding boxes by construction; spot review confirmed boxes/packages visible in all 100

sample.selection: reserved audit_sample.json, stratified random at dataset build time

verdict: PASS. Negative class is genuinely clean (0% clear package contamination in 150 reviewed). Dataset approved for AutoML training pending dedupe and split integrity checks.
